thread:
nina: heads-up, bringing up plugboard14b-int4 on canary. saw memory surge + intermittent OOMs with batch=8 and default max_new_tokens. also a small quality regression vs fp16 in our convo evals. sharing logs and config.
omar: can you paste the stderr and the exact canary config? :eyes:
nina: config: `model=plugboard14b`, `quant=int4`, `batch_size=8`, `max_new_tokens=256`, `prefetch=true`, `kv_cache=on`
nina: logs:
```
[2026-03-14T14:12:05Z] ERROR cuda: allocation failed: 3.2 GiB
[2026-03-14T14:12:05Z] WARN kv_cache: fragmentation detected, free_slots=1024, frag_ratio=0.67
[2026-03-14T14:12:06Z] INFO fallback: switching to plugboard14b-int8 variant
```
ryan: :thinking_face: int4 path might be allocating per-layer scratch for fused kernels. memory frag + kv churn explains the OOMs. quick canary suggestions: reduce batch_size -> 2, set `prefetch=false`, and lower `max_new_tokens` default to 128 for this model until we triage.
kevin: +1. Also flip on slot compaction and tighten eviction: `slot_compaction=true` `kv_evict_threshold=0.2`. that should reduce frag and reclaim slots sooner.
nina: applying patch to canary: `batch_size=2`, `prefetch=false`, `kv_evict_threshold=0.2`, `slot_compaction=true`, `max_new_tokens=128`. rolling now.
deploy-bot: canary deployed to cluster-canary-3 (3 nodes). image: inference:v2.4-plugboard14b-canary-fix
omar: run the eval harness after 10m and paste metrics: `./evals/run_dialogue.sh --model plugboard14b:int4 --seed 42 --batch 64`
nina: quick results (15m after deploy): no OOMs observed on canary, p95 latency +12ms vs baseline, perplexity +1.2, rouge-l -0.8. throughput lower but stable.
ryan: good, that's acceptable as a short term tradeoff. next steps: schedule per-channel quant calibration (MSE) and try hybrid int4/int8 for layers with large accumulators. also research kernel variants that reduce scratch.
kevin: will add automated test that runs small mem-frag stress during onboarding to catch this earlier.
nina: I'll file a short onboarding note and add the reduced defaults to model-catalog for plugboard14b-int4. thanks all :heart:
